/* ashlar ashlar_queue_r155 output-parity-r155-b1 */ SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_queue_r155 VERSION AS OF 1
            WHERE entity_version=16 AND apply_batch_id=decode(unhex('723135352d6231'),'UTF-8')) a FULL OUTER JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.schedule_r155_1 VERSION AS OF 0 s

/* ashlar ashlar_queue_r155 raw-parity-r155-b1 */ SELECT count(*) FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.schedule_r155_1 VERSION AS OF 0 s LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.raw_queue_r155 VERSION AS OF 1 WHERE apply_batch_id=decode(unhex('723135352d6231'),'UTF-8') AND source_feed=decode(unhex('73796e746865746963'),'UTF-8') AND source_epoch=decode(unhex('7363686564756c652d72313535'),'UTF-8')) r
 ON s.source_feed=r.source_feed AND s.source_epoch=r.source_epoch AND s.source_delivery_id=r.delivery_id
 WHERE r.delivery_id IS NULL OR NOT(s.schema_revision <=> r.schema_revision) OR NOT(s.apply_batch_id <=> r.apply_batch_id)
 OR NOT(r.record_kind <=> 'synthetic-scheduled-wide-edge') OR r.received_at IS NULL
 OR NOT(s.source_cursor_json <=> r.source_cursor_json) OR NOT(r.payload_digest <=> sha2(r.payload_json,256))
 OR NOT(s.published_at <=> cast(get_json_object(r.payload_json,'$.published_at') AS TIMESTAMP))
 OR NOT(hex(encode(r.payload_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(to_json(named_struct('source_system',s.source_system,'rel_type_id',s.rel_type_id,'id',s.id,'source_type',s.source_type,'source_id',s.source_id,'target_type',s.target_type,'target_id',s.target_id,'schema_revision',s.schema_revision,'entity_version',s.entity_version,'props_json',s.props_json,'retained_json',s.retained_json,'order_key',s.order_key,'source_feed',s.source_feed,'source_epoch',s.source_epoch,'source_position',s.source_position,'published_at',s.published_at,'lookup_hash',s.lookup_hash,'apply_batch_id',s.apply_batch_id,'source_cursor_json',s.source_cursor_json,'source_delivery_id',s.source_delivery_id,'old_json',s.old_json),map('ignoreNullFields','false','timestampFormat',decode(unhex('797979792d4d4d2d646427542748483a6d6d3a73732e535353535353585858'),'UTF-8'),'timeZone','UTC')),'UTF-8')))

/* ashlar ashlar_queue_r155 intended-r155-b1 */ SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT /*+ BROADCAST(k) */ b.* FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.edge_queue_r155 VERSION AS OF 0 b JOIN
            (SELECT source_system,rel_type_id,id FROM client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.schedule_r155_1 VERSION AS OF 0) k
            ON b.source_system=k.source_system AND b.rel_type_id=k.rel_type_id AND b.id=k.id) b FULL OUTER JOIN client_dev.ashlar_entropy_20261006_r86.schedule_r155_1 VERSION AS OF 0 s
            ON b.source_system=s.source_system AND b.rel_type_id=s.rel_type_id AND b.id=s.id
            WHERE b.id IS NULL OR s.id IS NULL OR instr(b.props_json,concat('"105":',s.old_json))=0
            OR NOT(s.old_json RLIKE '^"[0-9a-f]+"$') OR s.old_json=concat('"',get_json_object(s.props_json,'$.105'),'"')
            OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_system,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.source_system,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(s.rel_type_id <=> b.rel_type_id) OR NOT(s.id <=> b.id) OR NOT(s.source_type <=> b.source_type) OR NOT(s.source_id <=> b.source_id) OR NOT(s.target_type <=> b.target_type) OR NOT(s.target_id <=> b.target_id) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.schema_revision,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.schema_revision,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(s.entity_version <=> b.entity_version+1) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.props_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(replace(b.props_json,concat('"105":',s.old_json),concat('"105":"',get_json_object(s.props_json,'$.105'),'"')),'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.retained_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.retained_json,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.order_key,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.order_key,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_feed,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.source_feed,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_epoch,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode('schedule-r155','UTF-8'))) OR NOT(s.source_position <=> b.source_position) OR NOT(s.published_at <=> s.published_at) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.lookup_hash,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(b.lookup_hash,'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.apply_batch_id,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(decode(unhex('723135352d6231'),'UTF-8'),'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_cursor_json,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(concat('{"xid":"9007199254741101","seq":"',cast(s.id AS STRING),'"}'),'UTF-8'))) OR NOT(hex(encode(s.source_delivery_id,'UTF-8')) <=> hex(encode(concat('r155-b1:edge:',cast(s.id AS STRING)),'UTF-8')))
